caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical tin container with a decorated surface. The main color of the tin is dark blue, and it features a detailed illustration of a large building, possibly a mansion or institutional structure, in a light pinkish or cream color with multiple windows, a steep roof, and chimneys. In front of the building are symmetrical stone steps leading up to the entrance, flanked by green trees and shrubbery. The tin also has a decorative border along the top with a yellow-gold and reddish-brown pattern. The foreground of the illustration on the tin contains a border of stylized flowers and leaves in shades of blue, white, green, and pale red. The background is a light beige color, representing the surface on which the tin is placed, and behind the tin is a plain, light tan wall. Near the top of the illustration on the tin, faint red or orange text is visible.
title: Bandbox
